meta.name: dev-visual-verdict
meta.description: Visual regression testing — capture before/after screenshots of UI changes and compare. Use when a UI change might have unintended visual impact across components.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 对比 UI 变更前后的截图，自动发现视觉差异
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果每次 UI 改动后都要手动截图对比
copy.tagline_en: Capture before/after screenshots of UI changes and compare automatically
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you manually compare screenshots after every UI change

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 可以在 UI 改动前后分别截图，并对比两张图片的差异，最终给出「完全一致」「预期变化」或「意外回归」的判断。
howto.when: 当你要修改 CSS、重构组件或更换主题，且担心改动会意外影响其他 UI 部分时触发。

say.text: 帮我截图 Header 组件，记录当前外观。
say.note: Claude 会先拍一张「之前」的照片作为基准。

say.text: 比对 Footer 改动前后的截图，告诉我结果。
say.note: Claude 会执行视觉回归测试并输出对比表。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can take before/after screenshots of UI components, compare them pixel-by-pixel, and deliver a verdict: IDENTICAL, EXPECTED CHANGES, or UNEXPECTED REGRESSION.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you modify CSS, refactor a component, or change a theme, and suspect the change might cause unintended visual impact across other components.

say_en.text: Take a screenshot of the Header component to record its current state.
Compare before and after screenshots of the Footer and tell me the result.
say_en.note: Claude performs visual regression testing and outputs a comparison table.
